fullContentHtml:
RSSB Female Supervisor Result 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the Result for the recruitment of Female Supervisor posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 72 posts. Applications for the RSSB Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026 were accepted from January 07, 2026, to February 11, 2026. The online examination was held from 24 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RSSB Female Supervisor Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 06 January 2026
  • Application Start Date : 07 January 2026
  • Last Date : 11 February 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 17 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 July 2026
  • Result : 04 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer), EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

RSSB Female Supervisor Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
